steps.name: feature proposal
steps.explanation: An exact feature-branch snapshot is evidence, but it is not the configured canonical branch, so it remains a proposal.

steps.name: first canonical observation
steps.explanation: The first assertion on an exact main snapshot becomes canonical immediately; canonical status does not imply human confirmation.

steps.name: unchanged canonical replay
steps.explanation: Different summary prose has the same exact semantic fingerprint, so this is an unchanged canonical replay.

steps.name: canonical change
steps.explanation: The explicit decision key matches the current lineage but the exact semantic fingerprint changed, so confirmation is predictably high priority.
